status: adaptive follow-up after direct JSON overactivation was observed; fixed before code-readout outputs
dataset: datasets/vtuber-v4-intent-v1, unchanged development/calibration canonical clauses only
source: same pinned Qwen3.5-4B, frozen, no head training or new model downloads
question: Can constrained one-token intent readout reduce autoregressive overhead and permit activity calibration?
policy_change: explicit quiet-default and quoted-speaker policy; a new prompt, not a pure speed optimization of the JSON method
classes: 14 valid necessity/body combinations: forbidden-none, optional-none, six optional active groups, six required active groups
mapping: shuffle semantic classes onto single-token letters A-N; restore original semantic class ordering before comparing
selection: report every permutation and arithmetic probability ensemble, never best permutation
readout: one prefill, softmax of last-position LM logits restricted to the 14 valid letter IDs; record unconstrained allowed mass and top token as diagnostics
calibration: fit marginal necessity temperature, active/forbidden/required thresholds on calibration only using unchanged prior grid/objective; report raw and calibrated results
strength: editorial defaults 0 for none, 0.24 optional, 0.60 required; NOT learned strength; exclude from quality claims comparing learned amplitude
timing: isolated single prefill and sum of sequential three-prefill ensemble; no TTS/concurrency or live acceptance claim
limitations: Already-inspected 18-family development split, provisional assistant labels; prompt/order sensitivity is an outcome; format safety is imposed by the decoder, not proof of semantic correctness.
